## Goal

Review over any content, in a shell the artifact can't touch, with anchors agents can act on, and the shell's final design.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| RV-01 | Comments can be pinned on native DOM, canvas, kit charts, served iframes and opaque iframes (motion and video: RV-06; terminal cells: TM-07) | B | Comments pin and reload on DOM, canvas, kit charts, served iframe and opaque iframe fixtures (three engines) |
| RV-02 | Anchors store all applicable layers (semantic ID, W3C selectors, coordinates with viewport/DPR, screenshot crop); the crop is always stored | M, B | Stored anchors contain every applicable layer and always a crop; resolution order tested by removing layers |
| RV-03 | Review sets support gallery, focus, synchronized compare (2 to 4) and choose-one; the choice and comments are part of the draft | B | Gallery, focus, compare (2 to 4, synchronized, pixel diff) and choose-one; choice and comments arrive with the submission |
| RV-04 | The review overlay lives in the trusted shell; artifact code cannot hide or forge it | B | Artifact attempts to hide, cover or forge the overlay and its controls fail (browser tests) |
| RV-05 | `review export` produces Markdown and JSON with crop paths for agents | I | `mostra review export` Markdown and JSON goldens with crop paths that exist |
| SH-05 | The shell's visual design is beautiful and unobtrusive and passes Mirza's review | R | Mirza's review of the final shell design (D68) |
| SH-06 | The shell and kit work on mobile browsers (responsive layout, touch review and submit) for remote viewing | B, R | Mobile layouts in WebKit and Chromium emulation; external: real phone over tailnet; Mirza reviews |
| CO-06 | `@mention` in review comments raises an event hosts can route | I | A mention emits one event naming the mentioned viewer; hosts filter it |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- the shell's review overlay: pins, threads, resolve and reopen;
- multi-layer anchors with crops through the capture port;
- the anchor providers for charts, slides and timelines;
- review sets (gallery, focus, synchronized compare with pixel diff, trusted Choose);
- bridge injection for served frames;
- `review export`;
- `@mention` in comments raising an event hosts can route (CO-06);
- the final visual design pass on the shell (with design-focused review, D68) and the mobile layout.

Design detail for this package:

- From WP-07 (D113, D108): `ReviewSet` asks for the trusted Choose with `useChoice(id, { candidates, current })`; the shell renders it under the armed-control rules (`packages/shell/src/model.ts`) and posts `review/choose` on the shell channel. The current page arrives as `mostra/page` (`data-shell-page`), for comments to record. The shell's visual pass keeps the trusted zone's behavior: armed controls, frozen while the pointer is over them, state words reserved.
- From WP-06 (D101): results' `comments` (threads with anchors and crop paths) and `choices` labels come from the review layer; the Markdown renderer and its golden already show them, so the review layer fills the snapshot and `buildResults` reads it.
- Overlay, threads (reply, resolve, reopen), multi-layer anchors with crops through the capture port.
- Anchor providers for charts, slides and timelines; bridge injection for served frames.
- Review sets: gallery, focus, synchronized compare with pixel diff, trusted Choose.
- `review export`.
- Final visual pass on the shell with design-focused review (ask Mirza for design skills); mobile layout.
- Review endpoints live on the shell origin under `/a/<artifactId>/_mostra/`, behind WP-05's shell-session, Origin and CSRF checks and the `review` scope (D97, D98).
- Mentions (CO-06, D121): an `@mention` of a viewer in a comment raises one durable event naming that viewer, which hosts filter and route; Mostra notifies nobody itself (D10).

## Out of scope

- Terminal cell anchors (WP-23)
- Motion and video anchors (WP-21)

## Acceptance evidence

- comments anchor on DOM, canvas, kit charts, served and opaque iframes, and survive a reload;
- the artifact can't hide or forge the overlay;
- choices arrive with the submission;
- a mention emits one event naming the mentioned viewer, which hosts filter;
- mobile touch flows on WebKit and Chromium emulation, and on a real phone over tailnet (external);
- Mirza's design review.

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Crops of cross-origin frames come from the capture port, not from the page.

## Handoff

J1 complete: candidates, comments with crops, a choice, delivered together.
